fields.description: Page four of the Miami Life issue dated September 29, 1934. Includes an "Editor's Mail" letter (Mrs. K. B.) about poor conditions in "colored town" and tourist camps and concerns about malaria; a letter from attorney T. E. Fitzgerald (Daytona Beach) requesting back issues and discussing a planned tabloid; local gossip/columns ("They Tell Me," "The Real Low Down," "I'd Like To Know") touching on liquor, politics, and community news; notices and advertisements for Miami Life Day/Buyers' Picnic Day and local businesses; items on the Pan American Civil Service Institute opening; wrestling promotion at Biscayne Fronton (Oct. 2) and a theater calendar of upcoming films.
